## Description

Linearizes non-linear limit order book price impact dynamics using Koopman operator observable dictionaries, applying Model Predictive Control (MPC) to optimize multi-period block trade execution.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block order execution, minimizing market impact across volatile order book depths.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Order book depth profiles, historical execution volume curves, temporary/permanent impact coefficients.

## Caveats

Dictionary function expansion requires regularization to prevent overfitting in real-time execution loops.
